summary: QuidelOrtho filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 1 to its August 21, 2025 credit agreement with Bank of America as administrative agent. The amendment resets financial covenant levels through the fiscal quarter ending September 30, 2029, with maximum consolidated leverage ratios stepping from 5.50x to 4.25x and minimum interest coverage ratios rising from 2.25x to 3.00x. Pricing on the $1.15B Term Loan A, $100M delayed draw Term Loan A and $700M revolver moves to a leverage-based grid of 1.75%-3.00% over Term SOFR; Term Loan B pricing is unchanged. This is a routine debt covenant amendment, not a special situation; watch covenant headroom and any liquidity pressure as leverage tests tighten.
